## Quill Radio 3.0.4 - a launcher that says why, Up is louder, and OPML out

*Released September 28, 2026.*

Quill Radio is a free internet radio player for Windows, built from the ground
up for people who use a screen reader. No account, nothing to sign up for, and
nothing you listen to leaves your computer.

3.0.4 fixes the worst thing an app can do, which is nothing at all, answers a
listener whose volume slider ran backwards, and adds the one podcast feature
Radio had the way in for and not the way out. Install it over any earlier copy;
your favorites, settings, recordings and keys all stay.

### Downloads

| Download | Take this if |
|---|---|
| `Quill-Radio-Setup-Shared-3.0.4.exe` | You want to install it. |
| `Quill-Radio-Portable-3.0.4.zip` | You want it on a USB stick. |

Both are digitally signed. Windows 10 or later, 64-bit.

SHA-256:

- `9E76182B7577DD6C0DC44D8CA2C34BB2DA082D8BB36BAAC351BCBC4ACEF1263A` Quill-Radio-Setup-Shared-3.0.4.exe
- `33F90FA7C22FB50DBD4BB8BE52BD3737ED84284F0820306FD9850BDFE359BF29` Quill-Radio-Portable-3.0.4.zip

### What is new and fixed in 3.0.4

- **When Quill Radio cannot start, it says so.** A listener's portable copy
  did not open, did not say why, and left nothing behind. `QuillRadio.exe`
  starts the app's engine and, until now, threw away whatever went wrong. Now
  it keeps a launch log of everything the engine reports and, if the engine
  stops with an error, opens one plain message your screen reader reads on
  its own: "Quill Radio did not start", the reason in words, where the log is,
  and the support address to send it to. A missing file, a damaged or 32-bit
  copy and "access denied" each get their own words.
- **Opening `QuillRadio.exe` from inside the zip is recognised.** File
  Explorer, 7-Zip and WinRAR all let you press Enter on a file inside a zip;
  they copy that one file out and run it alone. Instead of "this copy is
  incomplete", the message now says the zip was never extracted and walks
  through Extract All.
- **Up is louder on the volume slider.** A listener wrote that the slider was
  backwards, and it was: a Windows slider on its own treats Up as "towards the
  start", the left end. Now Up and Page Up raise it and Down and Page Down
  lower it, on the main window's slider, in Browse Stations and Search
  Stations, and on every other slider in Quill Radio. Left and Right are
  unchanged, and Ctrl+Up and Ctrl+Down still work from the slider.
- **Export Podcasts to OPML.** Radio could import an OPML file and not write
  one. **Export Podcasts to OPML...** is now beside Import on the menu of the
  Subscriptions folder and of the Podcasts branch (Shift+F10). It writes every
  show you follow, folders included, and tells you how many it wrote.

The user guide's Troubleshooting chapter now opens with "If Quill Radio does
not start". The launch log lives at `data\logs\launch.log` beside a portable
copy, and at `%APPDATA%\Quill\logs\QuillRadio-launch.log` for an installed one.

**Portable 3.0.0, 3.0.1 or 3.0.2?** Update once by hand, because those versions
cannot run the newer updater: close Quill Radio, unzip
`Quill-Radio-Portable-3.0.4.zip`, and copy everything inside its `QuillRadio`
folder over your copy's folder, replacing files when asked. Your `data` folder
is not in the zip and is left alone. From 3.0.3 on, updates install themselves.

**Coming from 2.x portable?** Unzip 3.0.4 into a new folder and start it; it
offers to bring your 2.x favorites in on its first launch.
